page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs and 192 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 3.69 GB per vCPU. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached volumes. Additionally, there are zero integrated GPUs, which limits its applicability for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. The instance also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the dedicated Intel Xeon CPU allocation and the balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is designed for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without local storage dependencies. The resource profile suggests suitability for in-memory database deployments, such as Redis, where data is primarily held in RAM. It also fits general-purpose enterprise applications, caching layers, and distributed memory-bound tasks.
